Grab M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB $500 off, 48GB version $400 off and more deals

Beyond the ongoing July Black Friday discounts on AirPods Pro 3 and all colors of Apple AirPods Max 2 at $50 and $100 off respectively, the price hike pressure on the latest M5 MacBook Pro lineup is also showing signs of easing. Some highlights: the 14-inch 24GB/2TB M5 Pro model is $500 off at Amazon, while the 48GB model is $400 off at B&H.

Arguably the best deal since the M5 Pro MacBook Pro price hike, Amazon has dropped the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro to $2,499 with free shipping. Originally priced at $2,999, this model comes with 24GB of RAM and 2TB of built-in storage, $500 off the new pricing.

This deal is particularly worthwhile, given that Apple just raised the price on this configuration by $400, and even before the hike, it had never fallen below $2,340 on Amazon.

Another highlight of this week's MacBook Pro deals is the 14-inch 48GB/1TB M5 Pro model at B&H, dropped to $2,799 with free shipping. Doubling the RAM naturally costs more, but this is $400 less than the $3,199 original price, and this configuration is simply not available on Amazon.

Twelve South's PlugBug wall charger with built-in Find My drops to $40, new Amazon low

The Twelve South PlugBug 50W USB-C charger with Apple Find My is now down to $40 on Amazon, nearly 45% off the original price.

Amazon has now dropped the Twelve South PlugBug 50W USB-C wall charger to $39.99 with free shipping.

This product originally launched at $70 and was later discounted, with Twelve South setting the official MSRP at $50. Although it has mostly sold for around $55 on Amazon for most of the year, it has now dropped to a new 2026 low. During Amazon Prime Day it briefly fell to just over $40.

Beyond its distinctive and minimalist design, this product is essentially a practical everyday carry and travel companion, offering a relatively slim wall charger with two USB-C ports on the bottom, allowing you to charge your devices wherever you can find an outlet.

It features foldable prongs for easy storage and portability, with a maximum output of 50W, but the real highlight is the built-in Apple Find My feature. Like other third-party Find My accessories, it can quickly connect to the Find My app, providing standard location tracking and separation notification features — for a charger, this offers tremendous peace of mind, especially when taking it out of and putting it back into your EDC bag during travel.

To learn more about its features and user experience, check out my Twelve South PlugBug unboxing review.

Grab July Black Friday Apple Watch Series 11 deals starting from $299, $100 off, while supplies last

There's still plenty of summer left, and if you're looking to pick up a new Apple wearable, now is the best time to act with $100 off the most popular Series 11 models.

Over the past week we've seen plenty of special deals on higher-end Apple Watch Series 11 configurations, but if value for money is the priority (honestly, the top choice in my mind), the $100-off base model is the best option:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (original price $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (original price $429)

As of this morning/at time of writing, Amazon's basic aluminum 42mm and 46mm Series 11 models are still $100 off. However, we've noticed some case colors for the larger 46mm size are starting to sell out, so we recommend keeping an eye on them before prices go back up.

These deals are roughly on par with the best offers since launch, with the only exception being Prime Day in June, when some models were $20 cheaper than current prices. But as July Black Friday deals wind down this weekend, Apple Watch Series 11 discounts will likely follow — in fact, we've already seen signs of this.
